pricing.meta.title: Pricing — GSWAU membership
pricing.meta.description: Unlimited access to every GSWAU e-book and audiobook. $19.99 a month or $199 a year.
pricing.title: Read and listen to everything.
pricing.subtitle: Browse the site, read previews and listen to the podcast free. Members get every e-book and audiobook, plus the short courses.

pricing.faq.title: Questions
pricing.faq.q1: How do I get my books after I pay?
pricing.faq.a1: Create an account here with the same email you paid with on Gumroad. Your membership and books appear in My library automatically.
pricing.faq.a2: You keep member access until the end of the period you paid for. Books you bought individually are yours to keep.
pricing.faq.q3: Can I buy just one book?
pricing.faq.a3: Yes. Every book can be bought on its own from its page.
pricing.faq.a4: Payments go through Gumroad, which accepts cards and PayPal in most countries.
